title: On-time performance
body: All trucks on schedule. On-time performance: 100.0%. It has never been 99.9. You are invited to be proud of this. Outside, the hoverlanes keep their river of light under the limit — or just over it — and the city’s compliance looks beautiful from this high. Inside, the stamp is the only proof it happened.

outcome.text: The stamp is worn in the shape of those digits. No other stamp exists in the drawer. Through the window, a cutter passes without hurry — nothing to chase, nothing out of place. The number remains perfect.
